Healthy Cake
By: Sanja
Published: Friday, December 17, 2010 - 8:46am

Ingredients




3 grated apples
2 grated carrots
1 cup mineral water
1 cup oil
1 cup Mix ground walnuts, hazelnuts, sunflower
2 cups flour
1 cup oats
1 baking powder
2 cups sugar
100 grams raisins
1 juice of lemon
1/2 teaspoon of ginger
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon

Preparation

1 Stir flour  with baking powder, oat flakes and ground walnuts, hazelnuts, sunflower. Add  mineral water,  oil,  sugar  ..  mix  and  finally  add the remaining ingredients, combine  all  and pour into greased pan diameter  32  cm. Bake  50  minutes  at 200 degrees. Cool and then cut  as desired.
